message.content:
的 quan 威数据显示，there exists a big gap between the number of college graduates and the number of jobs available. 孔乙己仅仅是那个时代的 epitome，但是他代表了如今我们不愿意 step off intellectual pedestal 的学生群体，我们的 degrees 相对于是孔 's long robes which have made us too arrogant and lazy to do low-skilled jobs. 毋庸置疑，解决措施需双管齐下：
① 意识觉醒 Not be shackled by our educational degrees. 无论是去工厂拧螺丝 go turn screws in factories 还是卷起裤腿下地种田 roll up our pants and enter the fields, 人生价值 will be fulfilled in an unexpected way 生活最终都会给出一个答案
② 解决 job shortage 问题，让长衫不再是桎梏而是荣誉，时代的潮流始终惜才爱才，the scholar's robe is not to blame 而应成为让中华崛起的骄傲 当有一天国家振臂疾呼
))
☺
